overall: Partial — workflow implemented; supported autonomous discovery on unseen companies remains unproven.

items.requirement: Choose research angles and find public sources
items.detail: The model resolves company identity and ranks geography, business-model and regulatory questions; search adapters and official report-link traversal collect public documents.

items.requirement: Connect filings, results, industry, competitors and news
items.detail: The evidence graph can link facts across documents. Competitor/industry coverage is inconsistent, and media/industry origins are conservatively unverified rather than automatically treated as independent.

Python Decimal calculates shares, margins, changes, growth and CAGR using cited inputs with compatible entities, units, definitions and periods. Common metrics such as receivable days are not yet available as dedicated multi-input operations.
Financial hypotheses require numeric evidence and validated calculations. The graph performs follow-up collection, skeptic review, bounded repairs and a separate claim-support audit.

The skeptic requests opposing evidence and tests alternatives. Source budgets, blocked pages and account-free search failures can leave tests unresolved. No exhaustive contradiction search is guaranteed.

Findings link to exact passages, physical pages, required column-header context, calculations and original hashes. Invalid header/value assignments are rejected. Semantic and visual interpretation remain fallible.
The schema and renderer provide a one-sentence finding. The live trials have not established a supported, clearly non-obvious discovery; novelty is not independently measured.
The validator requires three to five source-cited bullets for each accepted finding.

Independent-origin gates prevent counting issuer copies as independent evidence. Issuer and regulator origins can qualify; independent news, industry and competitor corroboration is not reliably validated.
Timeline entries must match cited calendar dates or fiscal periods. Fiscal labels are not converted to invented exact dates.
Accepted discoveries must cite a validated calculation and its actual input facts. Unrelated entities' financial figures are excluded from target-company inputs.
Skeptic review and the finding schema carry a cited counterargument and alternative-explanation tests. Their quality still depends on retrieved evidence.
A structured metric, comparison, finite threshold, future window and expected public source are required. These are proposed tests, not observed facts.
A deterministic rating considers origin corroboration, contradictions and alternatives. Reasoning is shown; the badge is not a probability of truth.
The planner and hypothesis schema support this angle, but specialty/CDMO/domestic-mix extraction and corroborated change-point discovery have not been demonstrated end to end.

items.requirement: Regulation affected financials before mainstream coverage
items.detail: Regulatory facts, financial calculations and causal chronology are supported. The agent does not systematically establish a first-mainstream-coverage timestamp, so the before-coverage claim is unproven.
Geographic extraction and offline share-change analysis exist. Complete five-year live coverage and independently tested drivers remain inconsistent.

items.requirement: Work across any NIFTY 50 company in the track
items.detail: A dated official 50-company snapshot checks index membership and Healthcare classification. Live/historical membership and broad unseen-company research success remain unproven.
Passing regression tests demonstrates software behavior, not discovery novelty or financial truth. A live evaluation across several unseen companies with reviewed evidence is still needed.

items.requirement: Public information and no investment recommendation
items.detail: The supplied collectors use public HTTP(S) documents and search leads. Paid databases are not required. The discovery schema does not request investment recommendations.
Originality and compliance with team rules require a human submission review; the application cannot certify them.
